newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation steady 0.1 pct in Sept 16 week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation steady 0.1 pct in Sept 16 week.

text.p: Russian inflation was 0.1 percent in the week to September 16, the same as in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Thursday.
Inflation in the first 16 days of September was 0.02 percent, compared with a 0.2 percent fall in prices in the whole of August.
If current trends are maintained, inflation in the whole of September could be 0.3 percent, the committee said.
At current rates, inflation for the year could be 17.5 percent. Year-on-year inflation in December 1995 was 131 percent.
